recognize_zh: 雖標題寫切片，但畫面其實是骨髓抹片：大量核偏位、細胞質藍色有核周淡染區的漿細胞成群出現，其中有雙核與大型多核的異型漿細胞，指向漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderately abundant blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Atypical forms including binucleated cells and a large multinucleated plasma cell
Some cells with open chromatin and visible nucleoli (immature plasma cells)
Residual erythroid precursors and granulocytes; red cells partly in rouleaux
describe_en: Composite images show Romanowsky-stained bone marrow aspirate smears rather than histologic biopsy sections. There is a marked increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and basophilic cytoplasm, many present in clusters. Atypical features include binucleated and multinucleated forms and cells with less condensed chromatin and nucleoli, admixed with residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; the specimen type differs from the title's 'biopsy' designation, and clonality should be confirmed by CD138 with kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature and mononuclear without clusters or multinucleation and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
Consists of large blastic cells with prominent central nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBER-positive and in immunocompromised patients, rather than recognizable mature/atypical plasma cells.
Proerythroblasts have deep blue cytoplasm but a central round nucleus without a hof, and are CD71/E-cadherin positive rather than CD138 positive.
